title: Standardize component naming, resolve floating frames, and establish publish preflight
creator: Liam O'Neill
description: Background: Over the last two releases we've accumulated inconsistently named component instances, small floating/hidden frames that break exports, and variant state properties ordered differently across platform variants. This causes asset export regressions, token mismatches for spacing, and frequent last-minute 'undo publish' incidents. Goal: create a deterministic, script-friendly canonical naming convention, remove or anchor orphan frames, normalize instance/property ordering across variant sets, and add a Figma preflight checklist plus publish gating policy to prevent regressions. This ticket coordinates design-level edits and a lightweight Figma script/workflow that can be run by maintainers before a library publish.
tasks: Inventory: run automated Figma report to list components with name collisions, instances with local overrides, and frames not referenced by any component
Define canonical name schema (category/component/size/state) and publish naming guide doc
Batch-rename obvious collisions using Figma API script; create manual review list for ambiguous renames
Identify and either anchor, remove, or convert orphan frames into hidden variants (with PM sign-off)
Standardize variant property order (Primary, Size, Density, State) via script that updates component property ordering
Add 'preflight' page in Figma with automated checks and instructions; hook into our publish checklist in Confluence
Run a dry-run publish to staging library, validate exports (SVG/PNG) and Storybook tokens, and collect QA feedback
Finalize naming changes and push live library publish with rollback plan and a watch window
acceptance_criteria: >95% of core UI components follow the new canonical naming scheme
No orphan frames remain on the public library pages; remaining items have a documented reason
Variant property ordering is consistent across main button/table/chart families
Automated preflight run shows zero critical failures on a staging publish
Design handoff doc + publish checklist exists and is linkable from the library publish flow
